svg.title: ruPro workspace · learning across runs
svg.desc: Claude proposes a retry rule, Codex tests it, and the owner approves lesson M17. Catalog recalls M17 on a new read timeout. A simulated Catalog replay compares six passing cases without memory to eight with the lesson. Billing then checks a timed out payment against its receipt and records the owner’s decision.

g.font-family: Avenir Next, Century Gothic, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Why did the second read succeed?
The first GET timed out. A retry worked.
Try one retry on reads only.
Test Claude’s rule before we reuse it.
Checking reads, writes and repeat timeouts.
I’ll attach the results for review.
Lesson M17 saved with its test evidence.
A catalog read timed out. Any prior lesson?
Found M17 in Checkout’s approved lessons.
It applies to a timed out GET.
The retry returned 200. Writes stay untouched.
Now replay all eight cases with and without M17.
Both runs replay the same eight fresh cases.
A payment timed out. Can we retry?
M17 covers reads. This was a POST.
The payment may already have settled.
Check the receipt before doing anything.
I’ll read the ledger by payment ID.
Payment ID matched one ledger entry.
Receipt and decision saved with run 3.
